title: symphyotrichum praealtum var. texicola
intro: Symphyotrichum praealtum var. texicola, commonly known as Texas tall purple coneflower, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the south-central United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Texas tall purple coneflower include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant, making it useful for treating colds, coughs, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
